final.name: Coined acronym/brand name in the title
final.audit_justification: Whether the title coins a brand name is a naming/marketing choice, not evidence about the work's substance.

final.name: Identity-revealing URLs, handles and organisation-named hosts
final.audit_justification: Identity-revealing links are a producer fingerprint rather than evidence of quality, though the same well-resourced producer flagged this way may also do genuinely stronger work.
final.upstream_parent: author or lab identity and reputation

final.name: Artifact-release and availability boilerplate
final.audit_justification: Release-boilerplate density is a promissory/formatting signal, but groups with an open-science habit of stating it may also tend to produce more rigorous work.
final.upstream_parent: engineering headcount and lab release norms

final.name: Intervention-backed interpretability
final.audit_justification: Whether an interpretability claim is causally validated versus merely descriptive is direct evidence of methodological rigor.

final.name: Reproducibility specificity
final.audit_justification: Concrete reproduction-enabling detail is direct evidence of empirical rigor and completeness.

final.name: Reusable Knowledge Interface
final.audit_justification: Whether a representation generalizes and can be reused across tasks is a substantive property of the contribution itself.

final.name: Contemporary large-language-model and agent subject-matter vocabulary
final.audit_justification: This is a subject-matter/topic vocabulary marker, not evidence of the work's quality.
final.upstream_parent: production and submission timing (topical cohort of the corpus)

final.name: Enumerated contributions are genuinely separable findings
final.audit_justification: Whether listed contributions are genuinely separable findings versus one idea split into pipeline steps bears on the real intellectual content of the work.

final.name: Controlled isolation of causal contribution
final.audit_justification: Controlled ablations that isolate a component's causal role are direct evidence of empirical rigor.

final.name: Composable Mechanistic Design
final.audit_justification: Whether components have reasoned interfaces jointly resolving a stated failure mode is a substantive design property.

final.name: Positions against a specific account and names its gap
final.audit_justification: Specifically naming what an existing account gets wrong is evidence of substantive engagement with prior work.

final.name: Diagnosis-to-mechanism coherence
final.audit_justification: An explicit causal chain from diagnosis to design is evidence of reasoning coherence, not surface style.

final.name: Headline number interpretable and anchored to stated setting
final.audit_justification: An anchored, unit-bearing headline number carries real evidential content, unlike a vague superlative, so this tracks the substance of the central claim.

final.name: Existence-only proof vs constructive, demonstrated theoretical claim
final.audit_justification: Whether a theoretical claim is backed by a construction, algorithm, or demonstration is evidence of the claim's completeness.

final.name: Specific technical problem framing vs generic trend-hype opening
final.audit_justification: Precision of the stated technical gap reflects grasp of the specific problem, though the generic-opening anchor overlaps with templated phrasing style.

final.name: Uncertainty-aware reasoning
final.audit_justification: Explicitly representing and using uncertainty to guide inference is a substantive methodological property.

final.name: Formal symbolic texture
final.audit_justification: This scores sheer notational texture regardless of correctness or meaning, a genre/style marker rather than a quality signal.

final.name: Abstract length and sentence-count verbosity
final.audit_justification: Length and verbosity are structural/style measures, though an unusually detailed abstract may sometimes carry genuinely more substantive content.

final.name: Explicit comparison to named commercial frontier models
final.audit_justification: Naming commercial frontier models is a topic/subject-matter marker, not evidence of quality.
final.upstream_parent: submission timing riding a topic-fashion wave, combined with access to proprietary-API compute budgets

final.name: States conditions under which the claim holds
final.audit_justification: Explicitly bounding the regime under which a claim holds is evidence of methodological rigor.

final.name: Low packaging density: few coined acronyms, sparse raw statistics
final.audit_justification: This aggregates naming/branding and raw-statistic density, a packaging-style measure, though a less marketing-driven writing culture may also reflect a more careful research group.
final.arbiter_reason: The instruction operationalizes the score as a count of coined acronyms/brand names plus the density of free-standing statistics, which measures packaging and writing register, not the motivation, method, or findings; hype-free phrasing is neither necessary nor sufficient for sound research, and a strong paper that names its benchmark is penalized. A lower-marketing writing culture may still track a more careful research group, so report it discounted and undiscounted.

final.name: Structure-Matched Inductive Bias
final.audit_justification: Whether architecture is matched to the problem's structure is a substantive design property.

final.name: Conversion and formatting artifacts
final.audit_justification: Formatting and extraction artifacts are a production/conversion fingerprint, not a quality signal.

final.name: Promotional superlative density
final.audit_justification: Promotional superlative density is a hype/marketing style tic independent of the claim's actual substance.

final.name: Importance preamble before any contribution is stated
final.audit_justification: Amount of stakes-setting preamble before any contribution is named is boilerplate/template framing, not evidence of quality.
final.upstream_parent: writing coaching and abstract templates taught inside the producing group
